title: Ellua Renderer Eval
subtitle: Public visual suite for the headless renderer. Compositions are original fixtures; media is Wikimedia Commons / NASA public domain, CC Wikimedia SVGs, and an Apache-2.0 Lottie sample. No product-demo or private-project content.

cases.title: Primitives
cases.description: Core filled shapes, rounded corners, color interpolation, and parallel tweens.

cases.title: Eases
cases.description: Identical drop, eight easing curves including a seek-safe spring.

cases.title: Type
cases.description: Static labels plus per-character kinetic stagger from measured glyph widths.

cases.title: Fonts
cases.description: Same word through Roboto, Playfair Display, JetBrains Mono, and Fraunces.

cases.title: Type styles
cases.description: Apple-spot pacing: one cut on screen at a time. Regular pops, italic replaces it, bold slams in letter by letter, then a three-line lockup. No overlapping styles.

cases.title: Compositing
cases.description: Soft shadow, group parenting, nested opacity, and glyphs after a screen blend.

cases.title: Blend modes
cases.description: Every supported LÖVE blend mode on overlapping discs.

cases.title: Clip mask
cases.description: Live clip_node wipe plus inverted text outside a sliding pill.

cases.title: Motion
cases.description: Catmull-Rom path, organic wiggle, and staggered bar heights.

cases.title: Custom draw
cases.description: Pure f(t) escape hatch through the host graphics API.

cases.title: Vector
cases.description: vello_cpu gradients, bezier stroke, and deterministic grain.

cases.title: Effects
cases.description: Native adjustment pass on a raster-backed vector layer.

cases.title: HTML
cases.description: Blitz HTML/CSS card with tweened {{progress}} substitution.

cases.title: Page
cases.description: Full HTML document with linked CSS, woff2 @font-face, and a local image. No Chrome.

cases.title: Page bake
cases.description: Classic script mutates the document at resolve; Blitz paints the dumped DOM. No JS in evaluate(t).

cases.title: Flex
cases.description: Compile-time Taffy row solve, then item stagger from solved positions.

cases.title: Perspective explode
cases.description: Dashboard chrome, sidebar, card, and button start stacked on the page, then lift toward camera on separate Z planes.

cases.title: Perspective focus
cases.description: Tilted UI plane with the lens open; focus and truck pull onto the Publish button while the far edge defocuses.

cases.title: Shared camera
cases.description: One s:camera orbits two perspective cards. Far card (smaller dolly) draws first.

cases.title: World 3D
cases.description: A world is an offscreen RGBA node. glTF cube and a sphere pose from t; the camera trucks on look-at.

cases.title: Video
cases.description: NASA Earth-at-night WebM from Wikimedia Commons, cover-cropped with type.

cases.title: Video layers
cases.description: Two independent public-domain WebM decoders: plate plus a floating card.

cases.title: Image
cases.description: Apollo 17 Blue Marble JPEG with a slow Ken Burns push.

cases.title: SVG
cases.description: Wikimedia SVGs (compass, helium atom, NASA worm) rasterized by resvg.

cases.title: Lottie
cases.description: Official AndroidWave Lottie sample, frame-addressed through ThorVG.

cases.title: Audio mix
cases.description: Public-domain piano roll mixed under NASA video via ffmpeg, never the engine.

cases.title: FX chain
cases.description: Practical lights behind GLOW. Bloom and chroma breathe; Shadertoy is the pulse.

cases.title: FX passes (native)
cases.description: One panel per fx pass. In scene mode every pass except shadertoy runs inside the rasterizer (opcode 112).

cases.title: Wrapped type
cases.description: Column-wrapped paragraph with {c:#hex} color tags and a seek-safe type-on reveal.

cases.title: Mesh displace
cases.description: Grid mesh displacement on Apollo 17 and on rasterized type. amp/freq are timeline uniforms.

cases.title: Spritesheet
cases.description: Aseprite JSON+PNG, two clocks. Frame = floor((t−from)·fps) % n.

cases.title: Particles
cases.description: GO, then the burst. Same seed family, two colors, one firework.

cases.title: HSLuv color
cases.description: The word chroma on three fills. RGB muddies; OKLab and HSLuv keep the hue.

cases.title: Physics drop
cases.description: Colliding glyphs. Box2D runs once at compile with a fixed dt; render is ordinary x/y/rotation.

cases.title: OKHSL palettes
cases.description: Eight even OKHSL steps, then AURORA rides the ramp. Palettes as the picture, not a comparison grid.

cases.title: Grade / POSTER
cases.description: One night still. Kawase air, ACES crush, a poster sting, then settle.

cases.title: Charts
cases.description: A revenue card. Bars land, a rough line draws, then the mix is Q3 → Q4.

cases.title: Ornaments
cases.description: Studio ident. Linker writes the line, the seal turns, NORTH lands.

cases.title: Bounce eases
cases.description: One drop, one floor, bounceOut. The comparison grid already lives in eases.

cases.title: Captions
cases.description: Broadcast lower third. The bar writes, then the line changes with the VO.

cases.title: Audio pulse
cases.description: A kick on a mark. One baked envelope drives the disc and a row of meters.

cases.title: Spine pose
cases.description: A wave hello. Bones are the figure; hey. is the line. Pose from t.

cases.title: SDF type
cases.description: On-air bug. LIVE with outline as the signal and weight as the breath.
